src.heading: EXT. BHAIGAARA FOREST – FLOOD CHANNEL – DAWN

shots: Establish ENV-BHG-022 flood channel at dawn as rain begins again; knee-deep water only
Anaadhi moves unsteadily through knee-deep water; ADK-7 remains active from capture
Aarathi follows several steps behind, visibly maintaining distance to show she is not being dragged
Black-kite drones scan canopy above; no attack and no precise tracking omniscience
Aarathi switches on field communicator while keeping distance
Static, then Unnath asks her location
UNNATH (V.O.): Aarathi, what is your location?
Aarathi reports the subject is with her
AARATHI: The subject is with me.
Anaadhi stops and looks at Aarathi
Unnath asks whether it is a hostage situation
UNNATH (V.O.): Is this a hostage situation?
Unnath asks her to confirm it
Aarathi looks directly at Anaadhi before answering
Aarathi states she is not a hostage
AARATHI: I am not a hostage.
Unnath asks whether Anaadhi is armed
Aarathi answers no; do not introduce hidden weapon
Unnath asks whether Anaadhi will surrender
Aarathi says the operation did not allow surrender to survive
AARATHI: Your operation did not allow the surrender to survive.
Pause on Aarathi/Anaadhi distance while Unnath absorbs accusation
Unnath says central command is continuing pursuit
UNNATH (V.O.): Central command is continuing the pursuit.
Aarathi asks if it is his command
Aarathi tells him to tell his officers to hold fire
AARATHI: Then tell your officers to hold fire.
Unnath says he is telling them now
UNNATH (V.O.): I am telling them now.
Police channel distorts; no new interface geography
Anarvaa cuts through frequency and orders Aarathi to create distance
ANARVAA (V.O.): Investigator Aarathi, create distance from the subject.
Anaadhi body stiffens at institutional tone
Aarathi says the subject has a name
AARATHI: The subject has a name.
Anarvaa says Anaadhi is neurologically unstable; present only as his statement, not diagnosis certainty
Aarathi asks if he knows what ADK-7 is
AARATHI: Do you know what ADK-7 is?
Silence on channel; hold physical flood channel
Anarvaa warns against speculation without medical evaluation
ANARVAA (V.O.): Do not speculate without a medical evaluation.
Aarathi challenges non-consensual compound administration versus evaluation
AARATHI: You administered a compound without consent, and now you are talking about evaluation?
Anarvaa disconnects; channel drops without extra explanation
Anaadhi continues walking through knee-deep water
Aarathi asks where he is going
Aarathi questions returning to the same system after escaping force
AARATHI: You escaped this much force, and now you are going back into the same system?
Anaadhi says his body was found in the forest
ANAADHI: My body was found in the forest.
Anaadhi looks through rain and says his beginning is locked there
ANAADHI: My beginning is locked there.
Aarathi corrects him: not beginning, record
AARATHI: Not your beginning. Your record.
Anaadhi says he needs to see the difference
ANAADHI: I need to see the difference.
TP075/SB075 onset: forest briefly becomes Paraane corridor for Anaadhi; physical flood channel remains underneath
Seven-year-old Anaadhi carries medicinal plants ahead; Adult Anaadhi follows within represented corridor only
OBS04 limit: Aarathi perceives only a flicker of warm interior light passing between trees, not the full corridor
RST02: full corridor is gone; physical ENV-BHG-022 route remains; only source-authorized light flicker has been perceived by Aarathi
Aarathi says he is seeing something again; Anaadhi says something not here
AARATHI: You are seeing something again. | ANAADHI: Something that is not here.
Aarathi asks if it is real; Anaadhi says it is real to him; Aarathi says that is not enough for a decision
AARATHI: Is it real? | ANAADHI: It is real to me. | AARATHI: That is not enough for us to make a decision.
Anaadhi agrees: Correct; then says that is why he is going to Paraane. They disappear into rain — exact SC068 end
ANAADHI: Correct. | ANAADHI: That is why I am going to Paraane.
